notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green or blue is at least seven.
easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {G/U}.
description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least seven {G/U}.
Activate a land that enters untapped by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning the land that taps for {G/U} from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Nykthos
Activate Gretchen by paying {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card and put the land from step 3 onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
